claims.evidence: View A: attention is almost certainly on the upper location. That item is remembered as green and very likely a square. Its recoverability for immediate access is ~0.70, falling to ~0.50 after one step and ~0.36 after two steps.
the right location is very likely a red cross (very low current selection)
the left is very likely blue and circular
the lower location has no identified color or shape (flat distributions)
View B: attention is almost certainly on the left location. That item is reported as red and circular. Its recoverability is ~0.68 now, ~0.48 after one step, ~0.34 after two steps.
In A, commanding "upper/right/lower/left" robustly predicts selecting the corresponding A location (commands map cleanly to those locations).

In B, any of the directional redirection commands ("upper", "right", "lower", "left") are predicted to shift selection to B's lower location (the model predicts lower will be chosen for those commands).
